surface_mechanism_description: A single –NMe2 group in Sb(NMe2/rparenori3 reacts with –TeGeMe3 on the surface to form an Sb2Te3 film, and a small fraction of Sb is incorporated into the film by the thermal decomposition of Sb(NMe2/rparenori3.
evidence: DFT calculation expected the ligand-exchange reactions between the Sb and Te precursors to form Me2NGeMe3 as the byproduct. QCM analysis indicated that a single –NMe2 group in Sb(NMe2/rparenori3 reacts with –TeGeMe3 on the surface to form an Sb2Te3 film, and that a small fraction of Sb is incorporated into the film by the thermal decomposition of Sb(NMe2/rparenori3.
